visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark shoulder-length hair and a white shirt speaks to the camera in a brightly lit indoor setting. She gestures emphatically with her right hand, pointing upwards while tooth-shaped cartoon graphics float around her head. (2) The visual switches to black and white; the woman holds her cheek with a distressed, pained expression. Bold text appears on screen describing dental costs and pain while she mimics crying. (3) Color returns as she transitions back to a neutral, informative stance. She smiles and gestures smoothly, accompanied by sparkling animated overlays. (4) A brief shot shows her lying on a couch, smiling widely and making a 'V' sign under her chin. (5) Returning to the original studio setup, she continues talking, pointing at checklist graphics that appear on screen listing oral hygiene steps. (6) She holds up a large purple bottle of Listerine mouthwash, pointing to the label. A small picture-in-picture video appears showing her previous vlog content about empty products. (7) The scene shifts to a white-tiled bathroom. She pours the purple liquid into the bottle cap and takes a sip to rinse her mouth. Large text overlays display percentages like '25%' and '99%' to support her claims. (8) Back in the main studio, she holds the bottle while summarizing her points, ending with a call-to-action and promotional text for a specific e-commerce platform.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with a clear, engaging, and professional narrative tone. An upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM plays at a steady, moderate tempo in the background. (2) The vocal delivery becomes more animated and high-pitched as she recounts a past dental experience. A subtle 'ding' sound effect marks a transition. (3) The speaker's rate remains consistent while listing information. Frequent 'pop' and 'bubble' sound effects are heard, perfectly synchronized with the appearance of text on screen. (4) A short sequence features the sound of liquid splashing into a plastic cup, indicating the use of mouthwash. The BGM remains constant in volume and texture. (5) The speaker concludes with a persuasive, friendly tone, emphasizing brand details. The audio mix is clean, with vocals clearly dominant over the background bed and incidental sound effects.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Product Evidence -> Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a personal anecdote about expensive and painful dental surgery to establish a 'pain point' for the audience. It then positions Listerine Total Care as the optimal solution for preventing such issues through scientific oral hygiene steps, concluding with a promotional offer on a major retail platform.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product showcase, detailed explanation of benefits, brand logos, and specific promotional offer with pricing.
